about_short_description.short_description: Near develops an application platform designed to bring blockchain to a wide variety of mainstream applications.

product.name: NEAR Protocol
product.description: A sharded blockchain platform for deploying smart contracts and settling transactions, with support for high throughput, low latency, low fees, and confidential execution.

product.name: NEAR Intents
product.description: A cross-chain execution framework that lets users or applications specify desired outcomes while routing transactions across multiple blockchains and assets.

product.name: NEAR AI
product.description: Infrastructure for private AI inference and secure deployment of autonomous agents using confidential-computing environments and protected tool execution.

product.name: NEAR Chain Abstraction
product.description: A development framework that presents assets, applications, and transactions across multiple blockchains through a unified interface for users and AI agents.

product.name: near.com
product.description: A user-facing interface for trading digital assets across multiple blockchains and managing cross-chain transactions from a single account.

product.name: NEAR Developer Platform
product.description: Developer infrastructure, documentation, SDKs, and tooling for building smart contracts, decentralized applications, AI applications, and cross-chain services on NEAR.
